published.what: Fraction of the sky blocked by Butte M12 while Curiosity was parked at Quela (MSL sols 1456-1467), RAD view
published.dose_effect: RAD dose rate 4 % below expected (7.5 % for neutral particles) in Ehresmann et al. 2021; 5 +- 1 % in Guo et al. 2021
published.source: Ehresmann et al. 2021, JGR Planets 126(8), doi:10.1029/2021JE006851 (abstract confirmed; full text not readable, publisher blocks scripts)

definition: Published definition taken from the same group's method (Guo et al. 2026, doi:10.1029/2026JE009704, Sect. 3): viewpoint 1 m above ground, horizon elevation per azimuth (0.25 deg bins, 20 km radius) from the 1 m HiRISE/CTX Gale DEM; ROS(theta) = obstructed share of azimuths at zenith angle theta; the table value is ROS integrated over theta. Whether it is solid-angle weighted is not stated.

ours.dtm: HiRISE DTEEC_040770_1755_039280_1755_U01, 1 m crop to 400 m, 5 m regional grid to 2 km

verdict: Not reproduced. Our terrain gives about half the published value (10 % vs 19 %, 6 % under the other definition), and +-5 m of position changes it only by 1-2 points.
caveat: DTM registration is about +-2 m. The waypoint is the end of the sol 1455 drive, not a surveyed pose for sols 1456-1467. The DTM has no data 320-400 m to the west-north-west (azimuth 230-300 deg), which we treat as open, so our value is a lower bound there. The paper's exact integral could not be read.
